observed_partial_success.interpretation: Primitive curriculum transfers markup semantics but byte attention does not bind an episode-specific hostname suffix.

root_cause_hypothesis.claim: URL behavior requires a program-specific rule variable derived across positive and negative traces. Per-input projection cannot represent that variable.

minimal_change.name: Episode Rule Memory suffix head plus routed semantic adapter
minimal_change.episode_rule_memory: Infer the longest common suffix of positive string observations, verify at least 75% context fit, and expose only suffix, query relation, and fit as memory tokens.
minimal_change.routed_adapter: Use structured URL and markup tokens only on matching fields; preserve raw number, boolean, enum, and ordinary string values.

decision: Run the routed semantic plus Episode Rule Memory treatment on seed 20260801. If it clears both held-out family thresholds, run a raw plus identical Episode Rule Memory control and then the remaining seeds.
